_about: Image-based multibuy recovery (pipeline/multibuy.py), per store. Presence in 'stores' enables the stage for that store: it OCRs the item's wishabi cell render to recover 'N POUR T$' offers the Flipp payload collapsed into the bundle total. Enabled on evidence: kim-phat flyer 125 — 15 of 137 items carried badges, extractor validated against the campaign's 4 hand corrections with zero false positives (2026-10-17).
